input.body:
Hello Grace,

Thank you for your reply about the bedroom window at Flat 23, 143 Willowmere Road, Alderwick, ZZ2 6ZZ (ref R/PM046-1), which is not closing properly because of a rusted hinge.

Your email said "Felix agrees to have a contractor look at the window when convenient." Before we instruct anyone, could you confirm two things:
1. That Felix is authorised to approve works on this property on your behalf (or that you are approving it yourself); and
2. Whether you would like the contractor to repair the hinge on the visit, or only inspect it and send us a quote for your approval first.

A short reply such as "APPROVE repair" or "APPROVE inspection and quote only" is all we need.

Kind regards,
Donna
Northbridge Lettings
